tonight.headline: Jacobs is still in your lineup — move Gordon in
body: Bad news first: Josh Jacobs is out after finger surgery and is still in your RB slot at 0.0. Miami put Malik Willis on IR, so Gordon — the replacement — runs behind Kyle McCord. Bloodsports are 2-7.
As set, ESPN has it 110.7 to 111.6 and 49%. Starting Gordon for Jacobs is the whole 15.8-point gap. No waiver claim tonight is worth IPADE priority; claims lock at 02:00 Wednesday.

case.label: The risk
case.body: Mahomes' elbow is day-to-day but the MRI was clean and he is expected to play (NBC/Yahoo 10 Nov) — Rice's week depends on it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Mahomes ruled out by Friday — then Rice's 12.9 is wrong, and Wilson (12.8, if cleared) is the swap.

doFirst.title: Bench Jacobs, start Gordon
doFirst.subtitle: Jacobs is out after finger surgery and still sits in your RB slot — a 15.8-point hole, unchanged since this morning.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Fractured finger in Week 9; surgery this week, IR not ruled out (LaFleur via ESPN/NBC 9 Nov); maximum three weeks (Zenitz via Forbes 9 Nov). ESPN has him OUT at 0.0.

case.label: The replacement
case.body: Ollie Gordon II, 15.8 at Indianapolis — 94% of Miami's carries in Week 9 (archive). Miami now starts Kyle McCord after Willis went to IR (PFR 10 Nov); ESPN has already priced it. Marks (14.0) is 1.8 behind — a coin flip, so the projection decides: Gordon.

case.label: Not a drop
case.body: Green Bay's bye is Week 11; Jacobs can be back by Week 12. His open thesis says never a drop.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Jacobs is active in Week 10 (archive shows a Week 10 line for him).

whatWentWrong.title: Jacobs is still in the lineup, nine hours after the morning brief said to move him
whatWentWrong.lead: The lineup as set projects 110.7; with Gordon in it projects 126.5. Maye-day projects 111.6.

case.label: What it is
case.body: Week 9 was lost 106.96-121.92 (archive); Jacobs left in the first quarter with 0.5 — an injury exit, not a lineup call. Leaving him in Week 10 would be one.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing — this is a MUST CHANGE. It becomes a lost week only if Jacobs is still in the RB slot at 12:00 Sunday.
